entries.german: Her Anshelm von Rosenberg obgenant, liese ain newe scheurenn zimern, vnd setzt die [gestrichen: gen] zu Brasoldshaim vff ain gute, dar war der Carthausern zu Ostheim, Vnd als sich die Cartheuser des beschwedten, mach B Gotfriden zwischen inen ain vertrag, das berurte Scheurn, da stehn [gestrichen: bey] bleiben, vnd [gestrichen: erst] nach seinem Anshelmen auch [gestrichen: fraw] seiner hausfrawen dot den Cartheuseren erst haimfallen sollte, divers. entries.english: The aforementioned Anselm von Rosenberg, Ritter, had a new barn built and placed it at Prosselsheim on a property belonging to the Carthusians of Astheim. When the Carthusians complained, Gotfried von Limpurg, Bischof, made an agreement between them: the barn was to remain standing, but after the deaths of Anselm and his wife it was to pass to the Carthusians. Register of Various Forms of Bishop Gotfried, fol. 62. Date taken from the copybook.
